headline: A new train-only reasoning-surface class rendered through the LLM channel. Round 3 widened the holdout-bridge guard from the walk's endpoints to EVERY non-adjacent node pair: on kanto the guard went 76 -> 559 catches, i.e. 483 walks that state a held-out fact were shipping under the endpoint-only check.

provenance.round1: premise OVER_PINNED (walk pool 365 directed chains vs 20,075 connected sets, 55x); implementer LAND_WIDENED on the DETERMINISTIC template channel; reviews MISFIRES/SOUND/MISFIRES
provenance.round2: channel corrected to the LLM path (generic_synth's injectable generate_fn seam) after the orchestrator caught that the artifact made zero LLM calls; LAND_WIDENED; both reviewers confirmed the channel, alias merge and offline stub proof, and both independently returned MISFIRES on the same endpoint-only holdout-bridge defect
provenance.round3: the two builders died on the weekly agent limit; this repair was implemented by the orchestrator in the main loop from the reviewers' own required_change and fixture

the_fix.now: scan every (i, j) with j - i >= 2 over ctx['nodes']
the_fix.why: a walk asserts a connection between every pair of nodes it names; adjacent pairs are its own declared TRAIN edges and stay exempt, but any pair at distance >= 2 is a claim the walk makes without stating the edge — exactly what a held-out triple is probed on

red_green.red: test_holdout_bridge_covers_internal_pairs_not_just_endpoints FAILED before the fix with walk ['Professor Oak','Agatha','Elite Four','Red'] surviving selection while stating the held-out (Agatha, Red) pair
red_green.first_red_was_false: the first fixture used predicates absent from the test REL_Q, so all 3 walks dropped as 'unauthorable' and never reached the guard — a detector that could not fire. Fixture corrected to rel_q-backed predicates before the red was accepted.
red_green.green: 54/54 reasoning-surface tests, including both pre-existing endpoint-case tests (no regression)

expected_delta.instrument: walks caught by the holdout-bridge guard on real kanto, max_walk=3
expected_delta.prediction_stated_first: widening can only ADD catches, never remove; selected must fall
expected_delta.reproduces_reviewer_figure: 76 matches the round-2 reviewer's measured 76 merged endpoint pairs

estimand: TRAIN-ONLY; enforced over every constituent triple via split train_ids, not 'not in holdout'

round3_review.verdict: CLASS_NOT_CLOSED x2, MISFIRES x1 — zero SOUND out of 3 reviewers
round3_review.what_it_overturned: The class-closure claim in this receipt was NODE-PAIR scoped; the leak was at TEXT level. Every NUMBER here reproduced exactly under independent recomputation (76, 559, 483, 0/453, 501/521) and the red was confirmed behavioural. The measurements were right; the BOUNDARY drawn around the class was wrong.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: grounding_violations masked licensed names out BEFORE the scan, so a FOREIGN entity whose display name CONTAINS a licensed one was destroyed before the matcher saw it. End-to-end: walk ['Blue','Celio','Green','Ditty'] accepted "Blue is linked to Ditty, and Blue Oak belongs to the same chain." with ZERO drops — a fabricated fact about the distinct class Blue Oak, attributed to 3 real train triple ids, shipped into the CPT corpus.
defects_found_and_fixed.exposure: 235 of 453 selected walks (51.9%) license a name that is a token-boundary substring of another class; 233 shadow a DIGIT-FREE foreign name so the numeral gate cannot incidentally rescue them
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: scan first, subtract after — masking loop and sentinel removed; strictly simpler

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: missing_endpoints used the same bare-boundary search, so 'Blue Oak is linked to Ditty' satisfied the endpoint 'Blue'
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: endpoint must resolve as a WHOLE entity mention under the longest-first matcher

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: the holdout-bridge scan exempted ADJACENT pairs as the walk's own train edges. A fact held out in one DIRECTION sits on the train side in the other under a different triple_id and both collapse to one class pair — kanto has (Lt. Surge|opposes|Red) TRAIN vs (Red|opposes|Lt. Surge) HOLDOUT, and two selected walks stated it as their own edge
--max-fraction 0, the setting that turns the class OFF, planned the ENTIRE pool (14,881 walks x 2 variations = 14,881 LLM calls) because `n_walks or None` turned a 0 budget into 'no cap'
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: budget <= 0 takes the class-unavailable skip its own reason string declared

round3_review.tests_added: 54 -> 58, each carrying the reviewer's own counterexample
still_not_done: no live generation — the class has only ever run against an injected stub
no CPT run, so no install-effect evidence

5 selected walks shadow a foreign entity that is a HOLDOUT PARTNER of one of their nodes; on kanto all 5 are blocked by the unrelated foreign_numeral gate ('Mission 24: ...'), so that estimand boundary currently rests on a numeral regex and one digit-free alias in a future domain removes the accident
